svg.title: Ísland · Austurland · Jökuldalur · Hamrar
svg.desc: Four-step zoom map with Icelandic labels only. Top left: Iceland (Ísland) with its glaciers, Reykjavík in the south-west and a dashed box round the east. Top right: Austurland, the east of Iceland, with the sea (sjór), the edge of the great glacier and the river Jökulsá running from the glacier north-east to the sea through the valley Jökuldalur. Bottom right: a stretch of the valley Jökuldalur with its steep sides, the river, the farm Hamrar and, further down the valley, the church (kirkja). Bottom left: the farm Hamrar seen from across the river: the mountain (fjall) with two dark crag bands, the farmhouse (bær) with three wooden gables and turf roofs, the walled home field (tún), a sheep (kind) and the river (á) below.
